inputs.question: On the Preliminary Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21), what is the proximity of each transformer pad to parking areas, drive aisles, or vehicle circulation routes? Are any transformer pads located within 4 feet of parking or traffic areas? Are bollards or protective barriers shown around any transformer pads?
inputs.checklistItemText: Equipment pad installed within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes lacks required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) per AE Design equipment pad details, or bollards not spaced to allow equipment door opening
inputs.classifierReasoning: The agent is asking for proximity distances between transformer pads and parking/vehicle areas ("within 4 feet"), which is a direct clearance/distance measurement question. Although the agent also asks about bollard presence, the primary and compliance-critical question is the 4-foot distance measurement from parking areas.
